verdict.rationale: YYLO's integrations script can pull GitHub issues and Slack messages into its kanban and return completed responses to the source thread. Agents then work tickets through its Git-native Ledger task records (create, status, ready, get). That covers one issue source, but none of the trackers the story names. Missing for 10: Jira, Linear, ClickUp or Monday.com connectors; evidence that agents can update or manage tickets in the external tracker beyond replying; in-depth integration docs or hands-on corroboration.
